description: Returns a normalized, source-linked comparison of selected independent Orange County, CA car-rental providers. Use when: the user wants to compare two or more search results on city, vehicle types, monthly-rental capability, or published handoff capabilities. Do not use when: the user needs national chains or franchises, rankings based on guaranteed real-time prices or inventory, a category outside car rentals, payment, or a completed reservation.

business_ids.description: Required array or comma-separated list of at least two stable business IDs returned by search.

criteria.description: Optional array or comma-separated list of comparison fields: city, vehicle_types, monthly_rentals, capabilities.

name: compare
title: Compare Car Rental Providers
